extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators (new or unconfirmed editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia article (why a page might not exist, how to check for existing coverage, and what to do if creating a page). Useful for new contributors preparing a draft or requesting a page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the article directly, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article. Being autoconfirmed (an account with a small age/edit threshold) is required to create live articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permissions or are unsure about article notability/format, the article wizard guides drafting and submission; requesting a new article (e.g., via appropriate noticeboard) is another route.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Peacock comedy' in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check alternative titles or spellings to see whether the topic already exists under a different name before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal existing coverage or redirects and helps avoid creating duplicate or fragmented content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character)
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify capitalization and consider creating a redirect if the topic is covered under a differently capitalized title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created page visibility delay / purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you think a page was just created, allow time for the database to update or use the purge function to refresh the view rather than immediately recreating the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page was deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating a deleted page, review the deletion rationale and the deletion log to understand policy reasons and whether the topic or draft needs substantial changes to meet guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider adding a redirect instead of creating a new page
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the topic is covered under a different existing title or capitalization variant, add a redirect rather than creating duplicate content.
